info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Custody Asset Management API
info.description: The Custody Asset Management API facilitates the retrieval of detailed information regarding custody administration operations in financial markets. This API allows financial institutions and asset managers to access essential data related to their custody services, including asset holdings, transaction histories, and compliance status. Typical consumers include banking operations teams, compliance departments, and external auditors seeking transparency and oversight in custody services. By using this API, organizations can ensure efficient management and reporting of their custody assets.

get.description: Fetches the details of the custody administration resource identified by RES-100045. This endpoint provides comprehensive information about the specified custody administration, allowing clients to view its attributes and current status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve custody administration details for the specific operation identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the payload adheres to the defined schema for correct processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully and returned the requested data.

GetCustodyAdministrationByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving operations in the custody administration market.

GetCustodyAdministrationByIdResponse_200.title: Operations Response

settlementDate.description: The date when the trade settlement occurs.

quantity.description: Total quantity of the asset being traded.

settlementCurrency.description: Currency in which the settlement will occur.

custodianId.description: Identifier for the custodian responsible for the asset.

custodyLocation.description: Location where the asset is held.

positionQuantity.description: Current quantity of the asset held in position.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the trade record was last updated.

GetCustodyAdministrationByIdResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for operations request in custody administration.
